The crew went back to the bridge on Tuesday. The plate held.

We read all six gauges before the trucks came through, and every one of them matched the numbers from last month within a tenth of a millimeter. That's the result we wanted.

But the rail on the west side needs paint. It isn't urgent. It'll keep until spring if the salt trucks go easy on it this winter, which they won't.

So we wrote it down and moved on.

Next month we'll check the plate one more time and then close the file.
